name: Gdańsk
tagline: Hanseatic gables, amber and where WWII began
summary: Gdańsk is a colourful Hanseatic port on the Baltic, rebuilt after WWII. Walk the Royal Way past Neptune's Fountain, see the medieval crane on the Motława, visit the moving WWII museum and the Solidarity centre, and day-trip to Malbork, the world's largest brick castle.
seasonNote: Summer is mild with beach days; August brings St Dominic's Fair.
arrival: Gdańsk Airport is 25 minutes from the centre by train.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; trams and SKM trains to Sopot.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; carry a few złoty for market stalls.
foodTip: Pierogi, smoked fish and Goldwasser liqueur.
